entities.name: Arabidopsis WRKY51
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q93WU9; 194 aa; WRKY domain detected at residues 110–167.
Annotated as a W-box-binding transcription factor involved in defense responses; may positively regulate salicylic-acid signaling and negatively regulate jasmonic-acid signaling.

entities.name: Plant defense signaling
observations: WRKY51 reference annotation links the protein to bacterial and fungal defense responses and to salicylic-acid/jasmonic-acid signaling regulation.

entities.name: Nucleus
observations: UniProt Q93WU9 reference annotation places WRKY51 in the nucleus.
